profile_text.body:
DeepL is a for-profit AI translation company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Cologne, Germany. Its website describes it as offering an end-to-end, AI-first translation platform that handles text, files, media formats, and voice, with integration available through the DeepL API. The company describes its core model as a specialized large language model trained on proprietary data by thousands of language experts, positioned to deliver what it calls unparalleled accuracy and personalized experiences.

The platform's tracked product is DeepL, categorized under translation and EU-hosted, reflecting the company's European base and likely relevance to data-residency requirements. No litigation or SEC filings appear in the held facts. An MCP server entry associated with the name "ai.deepledger/mcp" appears in the registry but describes an AI accounting tool for QuickBooks rather than a translation product, suggesting it belongs to a separate entity and shares only a partial name similarity with DeepL.
